exposure: Mode of delivery (normal delivery vs Lower Segment Cesarean section (LSCS))
Pulse oximeter technology (Signal Extraction Technology (SET) vs Resistor Calibration (RCAL))
outcome: Time taken to achieve reliable oxygen saturation readings
finding: The SET pulse oximeter picked up first saturation values faster than the RCAL technology pulse oximeters.
mod_finding: There was a significant difference in the time to record first saturation readings of the two pulse oximeters when used in normal deliveries (p = 0.004) but no such difference was observed in Lower Segment Cesarean section (LSCS) (p = 0.968).
